tools.name: video_to_text
tools.description: Summarize, describe or extract timestamped metadata from a video in your workspace. Use an S3 URI for large videos; workspace paths are limited to 25 MiB.

videoPath.description: S3 URI in your current workspace, or a workspace-relative path (also accepts /tmp/ws/ paths).

prompt.description: Analysis instructions; defaults to a detailed description.

responseJsonSchema.description: Structured output schema, general mode only.
